note: What a node may depend on. A key that is dropped here is declared NOT to change the node's output; keep the lists conservative (a missing drop only costs a re-composite, a wrong drop hides a stale segment).

video_slice.comment: pixels depend on captions (words startF/endF/text), icon events, transitions, cards, ending, picture/icon/logo SHA. `path`/`*_path` keys are always dropped: content identity is the sha.

audio_slice.comment: ep04 ducks under the speech windows measured from the dialogue WAVs (mix-plan-v014.json speech_windows_merged_s), not under caption word timing, so a word-timing fix leaves the mix untouched (review-hd-v015 mux-proof: decoded audio md5 equals v014). The kit's segdeps.cjs audioSlice DOES include word windows; set include_word_windows true for a recipe that ducks from them.

pins.comment: render_script sha is NOT a pin: ep04 forks the script every version and the pixels do not depend on its file name
